title: Voxelarchitect day 226
abstract:
VoxelArchitect (Day 226)

This project features a custom Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) implementation and a DDA ray-marching engine for high-performance 3D rendering without WebGL. It includes a professional CAD-style HUD for sculpting 3D volumes.
